answers.q1: Yes. The app is recording a 1:54 meeting. Audio source is explicitly labeled: mic and screen audio. Currently at 00:02 into recording.
answers.q2: Yes. Bottom of screen clearly states: 'AIが見ている資料 — まだありません' (AI viewing material — there is none yet). No documents attached.
answers.q3: One application surface. The floating control bar at top integrates smoothly; left and right panels form continuous unified layout, not stacked separate windows.
answers.q4: Active recording status (red dot + timer). Meeting is 1:54 total. Listening to mic and screen. Two tracked topics: decisions and action items. No transcription captured yet.
answers.q5: Right panel empty and redundant — 'まだ発話がありません' (no speech yet) repeats the recording state. Action buttons below (summary, duplicate, decisions, actions) inactive/irrelevant until first transcript. Placeholder sections on left create incomplete feeling. Status '聞いています...' is somewhat redundant with recording indicator.

weaknesses.what: Empty transcript area + placeholder sections both signal 'waiting for input' — visual repetition
weaknesses.fix: Either hide empty sections until first speech detected, or show one unified 'listening...' state that covers both

weaknesses.what: Action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 複製する, etc.) visible but inactive/irrelevant before transcript appears
weaknesses.fix: Defer button row or grey them out until transcription begins

weaknesses.what: Large empty right panel creates visual weight imbalance during initial listening phase
weaknesses.fix: Consider showing guidance, tips, or formatting hints instead of blank space while waiting for first speech
